text:
emma_partner: Quick sync request 1: AuroraEdge + Snowflake + Databricks asked for a dry-run in our sandpit environment before any marketplace listing goes live. They want logo placement, co-sell blurb, and an on-prem demo.

tom_platform: Sandpit available. We need signed image hashes from AuroraEdge before we allow boot. Can AuroraEdge provide SHA256 and attestations?

kevin_sales: I'll ask them to sign the image and provide a download URL. Also they asked about a co-sell price band for the marketplace tile. Do we have a pricing template?

olga_infra: Pricing template is with finance but for demo we can show "contact us for pricing". Infra ask: we need serial numbers for the appliance so we can simulate device telemetry (no real customer data). Please don't upload real tokens.

jason_si: SI checklist updated: 1) SAML exchange 2) KMS mapping 3) sample transform to Databricks 4) vector index load to Qdrant. Who takes the runtime demo script?

emma_partner: @jason_si take the runtime script. @kevin_sales please collect the signed image hashes and AuroraEdge legal contact.

legal-bot: Reminder: partner quotes require written approval. No logos on marketing assets until legal clears. Send assets to legal@redwood.company for review.

marketing_ops: Proposed embargo window: send partners draft copy on Wed, internal exec review Thurs, external embargo 48h before publish. Need final screenshots T-2 days.

olga_infra: I'll provision a sandpit subnet in the us-west-2 region and a VLAN for the appliance. Sample command I'll run:
```bash
# create vpc and subnet for sandpit
aws ec2 create-vpc --cidr-block 10.24.0.0/16
aws ec2 create-subnet --vpc-id vpc-xxxx --cidr-block 10.24.1.0/24 --region us-west-2
```

kevin_sales: AuroraEdge replied with a signed-image URL and SHA256: 4f3d2a... They will rotate runners weekly. They asked us to whitelist a /28 and a set of ephemeral CI IPs.

jason_si: For the Qdrant load we'll use a 25k vector sample. We'll time indexing + retrieval and display aggregated latency only. No raw vectors or PII.

emma_partner: Fallback plan: If on-prem appliance fails health checks, run a live remote demo using Redwood Dedicated + containerized AuroraEdge runtime in our sandbox. Announce still happens.

marketing_ops: Who will draft the marketplace tile copy and three screenshots? Need to own this: short blurb, features list, and HW note.

kevin_sales: I will draft copy and get AuroraEdge marketing to review. Will loop in legal once draft is ready.

olga_infra: Security note: we'll enable mask-mode on telemetry dashboard. Dashboard will show CPU, latency percentiles, and token counts as anonymized numbers. No prompts or outputs.

jason_si: Runbook for dry-run (condensed):
- T-7: receive signed image + CI allowlist (owner: @kevin_sales)
- T-5: infra up (owner: @olga_infra)
- T-3: SI dry-run: SAML, KMS, ETL, vector load (owner: @jason_si)
- T-1: screenshots + legal sign-off (owner: @marketing_ops, @kevin_sales)
- Day 0: embargo lift + marketplace listing + demo stream

emma_partner: Action items recap:
- @kevin_sales: collect signed image, CI IPs, partner legal contact (due T-7)
- @olga_infra: sandpit infra + mask-mode telemetry (due T-5)
- @jason_si: full SI dry-run + demo script (due T-3)
- @marketing_ops: draft tile and embargo cadence (due T-4)

deploy-bot: Sandpit deployment scheduled: 2026-04-04 03:00 UTC.

emma_partner: Thanks team. We'll have a 30m post-dry-run retro scheduled. Please post any blockers here. :raised_hands:
